本框直接运行同源模板；使用模板自身控件切换页面或风格。独立全屏入口保留全部场景。

import { createApp as createOwnerApp } from 'vue';
import { AsamI18nKey } from '@asam-ui/ui/i18n';
import type { AsamI18n } from '@asam-ui/ui/i18n';
import { createApp } from 'vue';
import '@asam-ui/ui/style.css';
import '@asam-ui/pro/style.css';
import '../templates/visualization/Style.css';
import App from '../templates/visualization/examples/App.vue';
export async function mountWebsiteExample(
	element: Element,
	onError: (error: unknown) => void,
	i18n?: AsamI18n
) {
	const apps: ReturnType<typeof createOwnerApp>[] = [];
	const createApp: typeof createOwnerApp = (...args) => {
		const app = createOwnerApp(...args);
		if (i18n) app.provide(AsamI18nKey, i18n);
		app.config.errorHandler = onError;
		apps.push(app);
		return app;
	};

	createApp(App).mount(element);

	return () => {
		for (const app of apps.reverse()) app.unmount();
	};
}

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed } from 'vue';
import { AsamSelect, AsamOption, AsamInputNumber } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { AsamCardPreset, AsamControlSize } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { useAsamProI18n } from '@asam-ui/pro/i18n';
import type { CardPresentation } from './Presentation.js';
import { cardGeometryMessages } from './messages.js';
import type { CardGeometryLabel } from './messages.js';

const props = defineProps<{
	modelValue: CardPresentation;
	disabled?: boolean;
	size?: AsamControlSize;
}>();
const emit = defineEmits<{ 'update:modelValue': [value: CardPresentation] }>();
const i18n = useAsamProI18n(cardGeometryMessages);
const t = (name: CardGeometryLabel) => i18n.t(`app.templates.cards.${name}`);
const presets = ['small', 'default', 'big', 'large', 'custom'] as const;
const preset = computed(() =>
	typeof props.modelValue.cardSize === 'object' ? 'custom' : props.modelValue.cardSize
);
const customMinWidth = computed(() =>
	typeof props.modelValue.cardSize === 'object' ? props.modelValue.cardSize.minWidth : 240
);
function update(value: Partial<CardPresentation>) {
	if (!props.disabled) emit('update:modelValue', { ...props.modelValue, ...value });
}
function setLayout(value: unknown) {
	if (value === 'grid' || value === 'masonry') update({ layout: value });
}
function setPreset(value: unknown) {
	if (value === 'custom')
		update({
			cardSize: {
				minWidth: 260,
				padding: 20,
				titleFontSize: 18,
				bodyFontSize: 14,
				contentGap: 12
			}
		});
	else if (presets.some((item) => item === value)) update({ cardSize: value as AsamCardPreset });
}
function setMinWidth(value: unknown) {
	if (typeof value === 'number' && Number.isFinite(value) && value > 0)
		update({
			cardSize: {
				...(typeof props.modelValue.cardSize === 'object' ? props.modelValue.cardSize : {}),
				minWidth: value
			}
		});
}
function setColumns(value: unknown) {
	if (value === undefined || value === null) update({ columns: 'auto' });
	else if (typeof value === 'number' && Number.isInteger(value) && value > 0)
		update({ columns: value });
}
function setMaxWidth(value: unknown) {
	if (value === undefined || value === null) update({ maxWidth: undefined });
	else if (typeof value === 'number' && Number.isFinite(value) && value > 0)
		update({ maxWidth: value });
}
</script>

import { computed } from 'vue';
import type { AriaAttributes } from 'vue';

// Vue透传的标准ARIA与本预览专用DOM事件；不放宽未知业务属性或事件。
declare module 'vue' {
	interface ComponentCustomProps {
		'aria-label'?: string;
		'aria-current'?: AriaAttributes['aria-current'];
	}
	interface HTMLAttributes {
		onAsamPreviewTheme?: (event: CustomEvent<'light' | 'dark'>) => void;
	}
}

/** 公共输入允许清空或多种标量，页面模型只接收自己声明的合法值。 */
export function choiceModel<Value extends string | number>(
	read: () => Value,
	write: (value: Value) => void,
	choices: readonly Value[]
) {
	return computed({
		get: read,
		set(value: unknown) {
			if (choices.some((choice) => Object.is(choice, value))) write(value as Value);
		}
	});
}
export function booleanModel(read: () => boolean, write: (value: boolean) => void) {
	return computed({
		get: read,
		set(value: unknown) {
			if (typeof value === 'boolean') write(value);
		}
	});
}
export function textModel(read: () => string, write: (value: string) => void) {
	return computed({
		get: read,
		set(value: unknown) {
			if (typeof value === 'string') write(value);
		}
	});
}
ts
import type { AsamCardLayout, AsamCardSize } from '@asam-ui/ui';

/** 模板展示配置；仅透传公开几何属性，不保存业务数据或控件 size。 */
export interface CardPresentation {
	readonly layout: AsamCardLayout;
	readonly cardSize: AsamCardSize;
	readonly columns: 'auto' | number;
	readonly maxWidth?: number;
}

export const createCardPresentation = (cardSize: AsamCardSize = 'default'): CardPresentation => ({
	layout: 'grid',
	cardSize,
	columns: 'auto'
});
ts
const en = {
	layout: 'Layout',
	grid: 'Grid',
	masonry: 'Masonry',
	cardSize: 'Card density',
	small: 'Small',
	default: 'Default',
	big: 'Big',
	large: 'Large',
	custom: 'Custom',
	minWidth: 'Minimum width',
	columns: 'Columns',
	auto: 'Auto',
	maxWidth: 'Maximum width',
	unlimited: 'Unlimited'
};
const zh = {
	layout: '布局',
	grid: '网格',
	masonry: '瀑布流',
	cardSize: '卡片密度',
	small: '紧凑',
	default: '默认',
	big: '宽松',
	large: '大卡片',
	custom: '自定义',
	minWidth: '最小宽度',
	columns: '列数',
	auto: '自动',
	maxWidth: '最大宽度',
	unlimited: '不限制'
};
export type CardGeometryLabel = keyof typeof en;
type CardGeometryParameters = {
	[K in CardGeometryLabel as `app.templates.cards.${K}`]: Record<never, never>;
};
declare module '@asam-ui/ui/i18n' {
	interface AsamI18nMessageParameters extends CardGeometryParameters {}
}
const prefix = (values: typeof en) =>
	Object.fromEntries(
		Object.entries(values).map(([key, value]) => ['app.templates.cards.' + key, value])
	) as { [K in keyof CardGeometryParameters]: string };
export const cardGeometryMessages = { en: prefix(en), 'zh-CN': prefix(zh) };

<template>
	<section class="viz-chart" :aria-label="title" :aria-busy="loading">
		<header>
			<h2>{{ title }}</h2>
			<slot name="extra" />
		</header>
		<p v-if="diagnostic" role="alert">
			{{ diagnostic }}
			<AsamButton @click="retry" type="primary">{{
				i18n.t('app.templates.visualization.copyb8784c8dd5')
			}}</AsamButton>
		</p>
		<p v-else-if="loading" role="status">
			{{ i18n.t('app.templates.visualization.copyf020e4630a') }}
		</p>
		<p v-else-if="empty" role="status">
			{{ i18n.t('app.templates.visualization.copy497c85690c') }}
		</p>
		<div ref="container" :style="{ height: `${height}px` }" class="viz-plot" />
		<AsamFormSection
			v-if="series.length"
			:title="i18n.t('app.templates.visualization.copy82096213c9')"
			><label v-for="item in series" :key="item.id"
				><AsamCheckboxItem
					:model-value="selected[item.name] !== false"
					@change="toggle(item.name)"
				/>{{ item.name }}</label
			></AsamFormSection
		>
		<details :open="showTable">
			<summary>{{ i18n.t('app.templates.visualization.copye6f8674fcf') }}</summary>
			<div class="viz-table">
				<table>
					<caption>
						{{
							title
						}}
					</caption>
					<thead>
						<tr>
							<th>{{ i18n.t('app.templates.visualization.copy232527192f') }}</th>
							<th>{{ i18n.t('app.templates.visualization.copy515559957f') }}</th>
							<th>{{ i18n.t('app.templates.visualization.copycda1d55c52') }}</th>
							<th>{{ i18n.t('app.templates.visualization.copy6f24351d9f') }}</th>
						</tr>
					</thead>
					<tbody>
						<template v-for="item in series" :key="item.id"
							><tr v-for="(point, index) in item.points" :key="point.id">
								<td>{{ item.name }}</td>
								<td>{{ point.label }}</td>
								<td>
									{{
										point.value === null
											? i18n.t('app.templates.visualization.missing')
											: numberLabel(point.value)
									}}
								</td>
								<td>
									<AsamButton @click="select(item.id, index)" type="primary">{{
										i18n.t('app.templates.visualization.filterPoint', {
											label: point.label
										})
									}}</AsamButton>
								</td>
							</tr></template
						>
					</tbody>
				</table>
			</div>
		</details>
	</section>
</template>
<script setup lang="ts">
import { AsamFormSection } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { AsamCheckboxItem } from '@asam-ui/ui';

import { AsamButton } from '@asam-ui/ui';

import { useVisualizationI18n } from './i18n/index.js';
const i18n = useVisualizationI18n();
import { computed, nextTick, onBeforeUnmount, onMounted, ref, watch } from 'vue';
import type { EChartsType, EChartsCoreOption } from 'echarts/core';
import type { ChartProps, ChartExpose, ChartSelection } from './Types.js';
import { validateSeries } from './Data.js';
import { loadEngine } from './EngineLoader.js';
const props = withDefaults(defineProps<ChartProps>(), {
	loading: false,
	showTable: false,
	reducedMotion: undefined,
	theme: 'light',
	locale: 'ZH',
	height: 280
});
const emit = defineEmits<{
	ready: [];
	retry: [];
	select: [selection: ChartSelection];
	legend: [selection: Record<string, boolean>];
	zoom: [event: unknown];
	error: [message: string];
}>();
defineSlots<{ extra?: () => unknown }>();
const container = ref<HTMLDivElement>();
const selected = ref<Record<string, boolean>>({});
const engineError = ref('');
const engineFailure = ref<'renderFailed' | 'engineFailed'>();
const diagnostic = computed(
	() =>
		props.error ||
		validateSeries(props.series, i18n) ||
		(engineFailure.value && i18n.enabled.value
			? i18n.t(
					engineFailure.value === 'renderFailed'
						? 'app.templates.visualization.renderFailed'
						: 'app.templates.visualization.engineFailed'
				)
			: engineError.value)
);
const empty = computed(() => !props.series.some((s) => s.points.some((p) => p.value !== null)));
let instance: EChartsType | undefined;
let observer: ResizeObserver | undefined;
let frame = 0;
let revision = 0;
let loadAttempt = 0;
let mounted = false;
let disposed = false;
let media: MediaQueryList | undefined;
const motion = ref(false);
function resize() {
	if (!frame && !disposed)
		frame = requestAnimationFrame(() => {
			frame = 0;
			instance?.resize();
		});
}
function select(seriesId: string, index: number) {
	const series = props.series.find((s) => s.id === seriesId);
	const point = series?.points[index];
	if (point) emit('select', { seriesId, pointId: point.id, index, value: point.value });
}
function toggle(name: string) {
	if (props.series.some((s) => s.kind === 'pie' && s.name === name)) {
		selected.value = { ...selected.value, [name]: selected.value[name] === false };
		paint();
		emit('legend', { ...selected.value });
	} else instance?.dispatchAction({ type: 'legendToggleSelect', name });
}
function numberLabel(value: unknown): string {
	return typeof value === 'number' && Number.isFinite(value) && i18n.enabled.value
		? new Intl.NumberFormat(i18n.locale.value, { maximumFractionDigits: 20 }).format(value)
		: String(value);
}
function localizedOption(): EChartsCoreOption {
	if (!i18n.enabled.value) return {};
	return {
		...(!Object.hasOwn(props.option ?? {}, 'aria')
			? {
					aria: {
						enabled: true,
						decal: { show: true },
						label: {
							description: i18n.t('app.templates.visualization.chartDescription', {
								title: props.title,
								count: props.series.length
							})
						}
					}
				}
			: {}),
		...(!Object.hasOwn(props.option ?? {}, 'tooltip')
			? {
					tooltip: {
						trigger: 'item',
						renderMode: 'richText',
						confine: true,
						valueFormatter: numberLabel
					}
				}
			: {}),
		...(props.series.some((item) => item.kind !== 'pie') &&
		!Object.hasOwn(props.option ?? {}, 'yAxis')
			? { yAxis: { type: 'value', axisLabel: { formatter: numberLabel } } }
			: {})
	};
}
function paint() {
	if (!instance || disposed) return;
	engineError.value = '';
	engineFailure.value = undefined;
	if (diagnostic.value || empty.value) {
		instance.setOption({ backgroundColor: 'transparent' }, { notMerge: true });
		return;
	}
	const cartesian = props.series.some((s) => s.kind !== 'pie');
	const option: EChartsCoreOption = {
		backgroundColor: 'transparent',
		animation: !(props.reducedMotion ?? motion.value),
		color: ['#167d8d', '#dc9142', '#7a74b8'],
		aria: { enabled: true, decal: { show: true } },
		tooltip: { trigger: 'item', renderMode: 'richText', confine: true },
		legend: {
			show: cartesian,
			data: props.series.map((s) => s.name),
			top: 0,
			selected: { ...selected.value },
			textStyle: { color: props.theme === 'dark' ? '#e5ecf1' : '#334155' }
		},
		...(cartesian
			? {
					grid: { top: 40, left: 55, right: 20, bottom: 65 },
					xAxis: { type: 'category', data: props.series[0]?.points.map((p) => p.label) },
					yAxis: { type: 'value' },
					dataZoom: [{ type: 'slider', bottom: 5 }, { type: 'inside' }]
				}
			: {}),
		...localizedOption(),
		...props.option,
		series: props.series.map((s) => ({
			id: s.id,
			name: s.name,
			type: s.kind,
			...(s.kind === 'pie'
				? {
						radius: ['28%', '64%'],
						center: ['50%', '55%'],
						label: { show: false },
						labelLine: { show: false }
					}
				: { showSymbol: false }),
			...(s.color ? { itemStyle: { color: s.color } } : {}),
			data:
				s.kind === 'pie' && selected.value[s.name] === false
					? []
					: s.points.map((p) => ({ id: p.id, name: p.label, value: p.value }))
		}))
	};
	try {
		instance.setOption(option, { notMerge: true });
		engineError.value = '';
		engineFailure.value = undefined;
	} catch {
		engineError.value = '图表配置无法渲染';
		engineFailure.value = 'renderFailed';
		emit('error', engineError.value);
	}
}
function destroyInstance() {
	++revision;
	instance?.dispose();
	instance = undefined;
}
async function initialize() {
	const generation = ++revision;
	engineError.value = '';
	engineFailure.value = undefined;
	let created: EChartsType | undefined;
	try {
		const { init } = await loadEngine(loadAttempt++);
		await nextTick();
		if (!mounted || disposed || generation !== revision || !container.value) return;
		created = init(container.value, props.theme === 'dark' ? 'dark' : undefined, {
			renderer: 'svg',
			locale: props.locale
		});
		instance = created;
		instance.on('click', (event: { seriesId?: string; dataIndex?: number }) => {
			if (event.seriesId && event.dataIndex !== undefined)
				select(event.seriesId, event.dataIndex);
		});
		instance.on('legendselectchanged', (event: unknown) => {
			if (
				!event ||
				typeof event !== 'object' ||
				!('selected' in event) ||
				!event.selected ||
				typeof event.selected !== 'object'
			)
				return;
			const values = Object.fromEntries(
				Object.entries(event.selected).filter(
					(entry): entry is [string, boolean] => typeof entry[1] === 'boolean'
				)
			);
			selected.value = values;
			emit('legend', { ...values });
		});
		instance.on('datazoom', (event: unknown) => emit('zoom', event));
		paint();
		emit('ready');
	} catch {
		created?.dispose();
		if (!mounted || disposed || generation !== revision) return;
		if (instance === created) instance = undefined;
		engineError.value = '图表引擎加载或初始化失败，请重试';
		engineFailure.value = 'engineFailed';
		emit('error', engineError.value);
	}
}
function retry() {
	if (mounted && !disposed) {
		if (!instance) void initialize();
		else paint();
	}
	emit('retry');
}

import type { AsamI18n } from '@asam-ui/ui/i18n';
import type {} from './i18n/Parameters.js';
import type { ChartSeries } from './Types.js';
/** Validate before invoking the engine. Null is a gap, zero and signed decimals are values. */
export function validateSeries(
	series: readonly ChartSeries[],
	scope?: AsamI18n
): string | undefined {
	const ids = new Set<string>();
	for (const item of series) {
		if (!item.id || ids.has(item.id))
			return scope?.enabled.value
				? scope.t('app.templates.visualization.seriesId')
				: 'series ID 缺失或重复';
		ids.add(item.id);
		if (!['line', 'bar', 'pie'].includes(item.kind))
			return scope?.enabled.value
				? scope.t('app.templates.visualization.chartKind')
				: '未注册的图表类型';
		const points = new Set<string>();
		for (const point of item.points) {
			if (!point.id || points.has(point.id))
				return scope?.enabled.value
					? scope.t('app.templates.visualization.pointId')
					: 'point ID 缺失或重复';
			points.add(point.id);
			if (point.value !== null && !Number.isFinite(point.value))
				return scope?.enabled.value
					? scope.t('app.templates.visualization.finite')
					: '图表值必须为有限数字或 null';
			if (item.kind === 'pie' && point.value !== null && point.value < 0)
				return scope?.enabled.value
					? scope.t('app.templates.visualization.negativePie')
					: '饼图不支持负数；请使用折线或柱图';
		}
	}
}

/** Vite resolves this marker to its own emitted entry, including the configured base URL.

			new TypeError('唯一流 ID 必填'),
			'app.templates.visualization.streamRequired'

	const interval = bounded(options.intervalMs, 100, 50, 60_000);
	const batch = bounded(options.batchMs, 100, 100, 10_000);
	const retries = bounded(options.reconnects, 3, 0, 10);
	const backoff = bounded(options.backoffMs, 1000, 100, 10_000);

	let subscription: Subscription | undefined;
	let request: AbortController | undefined;

	let attempts = 0;

	let lastAt: number | null = null;
	let receivedAt = 0;
	let startedAt = 0;

		options.streams.map((id) => [id, []])

		options.streams.map((id) => [id, []])
	);

			state,

		const timer = setTimeout(() => {
			timers.delete(timer);

		++generation;
		for (const timer of timers) clearTimeout(timer);

			dropped++;

		}

			schedule(
				() => {
					flushing = false;

						const all = [...points[id]!, ...pending[id]!];
						dropped += Math.max(0, all.length - capacity);

				request = controller;

					const data = await pollSource.poll(controller.signal);

					if (token === generation && !controller.signal.aborted) {
						state = 'error';
						publish();
					}

					if (request === controller) request = undefined;

				}
			}
			void poll();
		}
	}

		start(next: MonitorSource) {
			if (destroyed) return;
			cleanup();

			attempts = 0;
			lastAt = null;

		pause() {
			if (destroyed) return;

			publish();
		},
		resume() {
			if (!destroyed && state === 'paused') {

			}
		},
		reconnect() {
			if (!destroyed) {

			}
		},
		close() {
			if (destroyed) return;
			cleanup();
			state = 'closed';
			publish();
		},
		dispose() {
			cleanup();
			state = 'closed';
			destroyed = true;
		},

		resources: () => ({
			timers: timers.size,
			subscription: !!subscription,
			request: !!request,
			pending: Object.values(pending).reduce((n, p) => n + p.length, 0)

	};

import { createAsamMessageError } from '@asam-ui/pro/i18n';
import type {} from './i18n/Parameters.js';
import { createRequestClient, TransportFault } from '@asam-ui/pro/application/transport';
import type {
	AnalyticsData,
	AnalyticsFilter,
	PollSource,
	StreamPoint,
	SubscribeSource
} from './Types.js';
import type { RequestClient } from '@asam-ui/pro/application/transport';
export interface AnalyticsService {
	readonly client: RequestClient;
	load(filter: AnalyticsFilter, signal: AbortSignal): Promise<AnalyticsData>;
}
export function decodeAnalytics(data: unknown): AnalyticsData {
	if (
		typeof data !== 'object' ||
		!data ||
		!('points' in data) ||
		!Array.isArray(data.points) ||
		!('total' in data) ||
		typeof data.total !== 'number' ||
		!Number.isFinite(data.total) ||
		!('partial' in data) ||
		typeof data.partial !== 'boolean'
	)
		throw createAsamMessageError(
			new TypeError('无效分析响应'),
			'app.templates.visualization.invalidResponse'
		);
	const ids = new Set<string>();
	const points = data.points.map((p: unknown) => {
		if (
			typeof p !== 'object' ||
			!p ||
			!('id' in p) ||
			typeof p.id !== 'string' ||
			ids.has(p.id) ||
			!('label' in p) ||
			typeof p.label !== 'string' ||
			!('value' in p) ||
			(p.value !== null && (typeof p.value !== 'number' || !Number.isFinite(p.value)))
		)
			throw createAsamMessageError(
				new TypeError('无效分析点'),
				'app.templates.visualization.invalidPoint'
			);
		ids.add(p.id);
		return { id: p.id, label: p.label, value: p.value };
	});
	return { points, total: data.total, partial: data.partial };
}
/** Replace this local deterministic transport at application composition; no CL backend implied. */
export function createLocalAnalyticsService(): AnalyticsService {
	const client = createRequestClient({
		transport: async (input, context) => {
			const filter = input.params as unknown as AnalyticsFilter;
			await new Promise<void>((resolve, reject) => {
				const timer = setTimeout(resolve, filter.delayMs ?? 70);
				context.signal.addEventListener(
					'abort',
					() => {
						clearTimeout(timer);
						reject(new TransportFault('cancelled'));
					},
					{ once: true }
				);
			});
			if (filter.mode === 'error') throw new TransportFault('network');
			const length =
				filter.mode === 'empty'
					? 0
					: filter.mode === 'partial'
						? Math.floor(filter.range / 2)
						: filter.range;
			const multiplier =
				filter.category === 'north' ? 1.4 : filter.category === 'south' ? 0.7 : 1;
			const points = Array.from({ length }, (_, i) => ({
				id: String(i),
				label: `时段 ${i + 1}`,
				value:
					i % 97 === 0
						? null
						: Math.round((40 + Math.sin(i / 17) * 15 + (i % 13)) * multiplier * 100) /
							100
			}));
			return {
				mode: 'data',
				data: {
					points,
					total: points.reduce((n, p) => n + (p.value ?? 0), 0),
					partial: filter.mode === 'partial'
				}
			};
		}
	});
	return {
		client,
		load: (filter, signal) =>
			client.request(
				{ url: 'local:analytics', params: { ...filter } },

	};
}
export function createSseSource(url: string, id = '本地 SSE'): SubscribeSource {
	return {
		id,
		subscribe(sink) {
			const event = new EventSource(url);
			event.onopen = () => sink.open();
			event.onmessage = (e) => {
				try {
					sink.message(JSON.parse(e.data) as StreamPoint);
				} catch {
					event.close();
					sink.error();
				}
			};
			event.onerror = () => {
				event.close();
				sink.error();
			};
			return {
				close() {
					event.onopen = null;
					event.onmessage = null;
					event.onerror = null;
					event.close();
				}
			};
		}
	};
}
export function createPollingSource(
	client: RequestClient,
	url: string,

	return {
		id,

				{ url },

					signal,

					}
				}
			)
	};
}
css
.viz-shell {
	--viz-bg: var(--asam-color-surface-muted, #f3f6f7);
	--viz-surface: var(--asam-color-surface, #fff);
	--viz-text: var(--asam-color-text-primary, #20363e);
	--viz-border: var(--asam-color-border, #d8e1e5);
	--viz-control: 32px;
	background: var(--viz-bg);
	color: var(--viz-text);
	min-height: 100%;
	font: 14px/1.5 var(--asam-typography-font-family, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif);
}
.viz-shell.dark {
	color-scheme: dark;
}
.viz-shell[data-size='large'] {
	--viz-control: 40px;
}
.viz-shell[data-size='big'] {
	--viz-control: 36px;
}
.viz-shell[data-size='small'] {
	--viz-control: 28px;
}
body {
	margin: 0;
}
.viz-shell * {
	box-sizing: border-box;
}
.viz-shell nav {
	display: flex;
	align-items: center;
	gap: 16px;
	padding: 16px 3vw;
	border-bottom: 1px solid var(--viz-border);
	background: var(--viz-surface);
	flex-wrap: wrap;
}
.viz-shell nav strong {
	margin-right: auto;
	letter-spacing: 0.12em;
}
.viz-shell small {
	font-size: 10px;
	font-weight: 400;
}
.viz-shell button:not([class*='el-']),
.viz-shell input:not([class*='el-']),
.viz-shell select:not([class*='el-']) {
	font: inherit;
	color: inherit;
	background: var(--viz-surface);
	border: 1px solid var(--viz-border);
	border-radius: var(--asam-radius-control, 4px);
	min-height: var(--viz-control);
	line-height: 20px;
	padding: 3px 10px;
}
.viz-shell button:not([class*='el-']) {
	cursor: pointer;
}
.viz-shell button:not([class*='el-']):hover,
.viz-shell [aria-current='page']:not(.el-button) {
	border-color: var(--asam-semantic-primary-foreground);
	color: var(--asam-semantic-primary-foreground);
}
.viz-shell :focus-visible {
	outline: 3px solid var(--asam-semantic-focus);
	outline-offset: 3px;
}
.viz-shell input:not([class*='el-'])[type='checkbox'] {
	min-height: 0;
}
.viz-page {
	max-width: 1600px;
	margin: auto;
	padding: 28px 3vw;
}
.viz-heading {
	display: flex;
	justify-content: space-between;
	align-items: center;
	gap: 16px;
	margin-bottom: 22px;
}
.viz-heading h1 {
	font-size: 32px;
	letter-spacing: -0.035em;
	margin: 4px 0;
}
.viz-heading p {
	margin: 0;
	color: var(--asam-color-text-secondary, #657983);
}
.viz-eyebrow {
	font-size: 11px;
	letter-spacing: 0.12em;
}
.viz-toolbar {
	display: flex;
	align-items: end;
	gap: 12px;
	flex-wrap: wrap;
	margin-bottom: 16px;
}
.viz-toolbar label {
	display: grid;
	gap: 4px;
	font-size: 12px;
}
.viz-shell nav label {
	display: flex;
	align-items: center;
	gap: 5px;
}
.viz-analysis-grid {
	display: grid;
	grid-template-columns: 1.4fr 1fr;
	gap: 18px;
	margin-top: 24px;
}
.viz-analysis-grid > .viz-chart:first-child {
	grid-column: 1/-1;
}
.viz-monitor-grid {
	display: grid;
	grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
	gap: 16px;
	margin-top: 24px;
}
.viz-chart {
	min-width: 0;
	padding: 18px;
	background: var(--viz-surface);
	border: 1px solid var(--viz-border);
	border-radius: var(--asam-radius-card, 8px);
}
.viz-chart header {
	display: flex;
	justify-content: space-between;
}
.viz-chart h2 {
	font-size: 15px;
	margin: 0 0 12px;
}
.viz-chart .asam-form-section {
	border: 0;
	padding: 0;
	display: flex;
	gap: 12px;
	font-size: 12px;
}
.viz-chart .asam-form-section-title {
	font-size: 11px;
	color: var(--asam-color-text-secondary, #657983);
}
.viz-plot {
	width: 100%;
}
.viz-chart summary {
	cursor: pointer;
	font-size: 12px;
	margin-top: 12px;
}
.viz-table {
	max-height: 260px;
	overflow: auto;
}
.viz-table table {
	border-collapse: collapse;
	width: 100%;
	font-size: 12px;
}
.viz-table th,
.viz-table td {
	text-align: left;
	padding: 6px;
	border-bottom: 1px solid var(--viz-border);
}
.viz-status {
	border: 1px solid var(--viz-border);
	padding: 6px 12px;
	border-radius: 20px;
}
.viz-shell .asam-card-group {
	margin: 18px 0;
}
@media (max-width: 700px) {
	.viz-analysis-grid,
	.viz-monitor-grid {
		grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
	}
	.viz-heading h1 {
		font-size: 26px;
	}
	.viz-shell nav {
		gap: 9px;
	}
	.viz-shell nav strong {
		width: 100%;
	}
	.viz-toolbar input:not([class*='el-']) {
		max-width: 100%;
	}
	.viz-chart {
		padding: 12px;
	}
	.viz-page {
		padding: 20px 14px;
	}
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference) {
	.viz-shell button:not([class*='el-']) {
		transition:
			border-color 0.15s,
			color 0.15s;
	}
	.viz-page {
		animation: viz-enter 0.18s ease-out;
	}
	@keyframes viz-enter {
		from {
			opacity: 0.4;
			transform: translateY(3px);
		}
		to {
			opacity: 1;
			transform: none;
		}
	}
}

import type { EChartsCoreOption, EChartsType } from 'echarts/core';
export type ChartKind = 'line' | 'bar' | 'pie';
export interface ChartPoint {
	readonly id: string;
	readonly label: string;
	readonly value: number | null;
}
export interface ChartSeries {

								><AsamOption

											i18n.t('app.templates.visualization.copy2f8267a89a')
										).trim()

<script setup lang="ts">
import { AsamConfigProvider as WebsiteAsamConfigProvider } from '@asam-ui/ui';
const websitePreviewControls =
	typeof document !== 'undefined' && !!document.getElementById('preview-settings-extra');

import { AsamSelect, AsamOption, defineAsamOptions } from '@asam-ui/ui';

import { AsamButton } from '@asam-ui/ui';

import { useVisualizationI18n } from '../i18n/index.js';
const i18n = useVisualizationI18n();
import { computed, onBeforeUnmount, onMounted, reactive, ref } from 'vue';
import { AsamCardGroup, AsamSearchForm, AsamStatisticCard } from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import type { AsamFieldDefinition, AsamFieldModel } from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import ChartHost from '../ChartHost.vue';
import { createLatestRequest } from '@asam-ui/pro/application/transport';
import { decodeAnalytics } from '../Services.js';
import type { AnalyticsService } from '../Services.js';
import type { AnalyticsData, AnalyticsFilter, ChartKind, ChartSeries } from '../Types.js';
import type { CardPresentation } from '../../cards/Presentation.js';
import { choiceModel } from '../../cards/Models.js';
const props = defineProps<{
	service: AnalyticsService;
	theme: 'light' | 'dark';
	locale: 'ZH' | 'EN';
	cardPresentation?: CardPresentation;
}>();
const queryDefaults = { category: 'all', range: 1000 } as const;
const filter = reactive<AnalyticsFilter>({ ...queryDefaults, mode: 'normal' });
const queryDraft = computed<AsamFieldModel>({
	get: () => ({ category: filter.category, range: filter.range }),
	set: ({ category, range }) => {
		if (category === 'all' || category === 'north' || category === 'south')
			filter.category = category;
		if (range === 1000 || range === 100 || range === 30) filter.range = range;
	}
});
const fields = computed<readonly AsamFieldDefinition[]>(() => [
	{
		key: 'category',
		kind: 'single',
		label: i18n.t('app.templates.visualization.copy3382870bc4'),
		source: defineAsamOptions().static({
			options: [
				{ value: 'all', label: i18n.t('app.templates.visualization.copy83a18b9cc6') },
				{ value: 'north', label: i18n.t('app.templates.visualization.copy043bf68117') },
				{ value: 'south', label: i18n.t('app.templates.visualization.copydf398d3794') }
			]
		}),
		modes: { query: { componentProps: { onChange: load } } }
	},
	{
		key: 'range',
		kind: 'single',
		label: i18n.t('app.templates.visualization.copyae72b532f4'),
		source: defineAsamOptions().static({
			options: [
				{ value: 1000, label: i18n.t('app.templates.visualization.copy1a4ab19919') },
				{ value: 100, label: i18n.t('app.templates.visualization.copy9d35440791') },
				{ value: 30, label: i18n.t('app.templates.visualization.copy2387e543cf') }
			]
		}),
		modes: { query: { componentProps: { onChange: load } } }
	}
]);
const modeModel = choiceModel(
	() => filter.mode,
	(value) => {
		filter.mode = value;
	},
	['normal', 'empty', 'partial', 'error']
);
const data = ref<AnalyticsData>({ points: [], total: 0, partial: false });
const loading = ref(false);
const error = ref('');
const selected = ref('');
const zoom = ref('');
const windowRange = ref<[number, number]>([0, 100]);
const kinds: ChartKind[] = ['line', 'bar', 'pie'];
const titles = computed(() => ({
	line: i18n.t('app.templates.visualization.lineTitle'),
	bar: i18n.t('app.templates.visualization.barTitle'),
	pie: i18n.t('app.templates.visualization.pieTitle')
}));
const filtered = computed(() =>
	selected.value
		? data.value.points.filter((p) => p.id === selected.value)
		: data.value.points.slice(
				Math.floor((data.value.points.length * windowRange.value[0]) / 100),
				Math.ceil((data.value.points.length * windowRange.value[1]) / 100)
			)
);
const total = computed(() => filtered.value.reduce((n, p) => n + (p.value ?? 0), 0));
const validCount = computed(() => filtered.value.filter((p) => p.value !== null).length);
const status = computed(() =>
	loading.value
		? 'loading'
		: error.value
			? 'error'
			: !data.value.points.length
				? 'empty'
				: 'ready'
);
const latest = createLatestRequest<AnalyticsData>(props.service.client, (result) => {
	data.value = result;
	selected.value = '';
	windowRange.value = [0, 100];
});
let revision = 0;
async function load() {
	const token = ++revision;
	loading.value = true;
	error.value = '';
	try {
		await latest.load(
			{ url: 'local:analytics', params: { ...filter } },
			{ decode: decodeAnalytics }
		);
	} catch {
		if (token === revision) error.value = '分析加载失败，请重试';
	} finally {
		if (token === revision) loading.value = false;
	}
}
function reset() {
	filter.mode = 'normal';
	selected.value = '';
	void load();
}
function series(kind: ChartKind): ChartSeries[] {
	return [
		{
			id: kind,
			name: filter.category === 'all' ? '全部区域' : filter.category,
			kind,
			points: filtered.value
		}
	];
}
function applyZoom(event: unknown) {
	if (!event || typeof event !== 'object') return;
	const payload = 'batch' in event && Array.isArray(event.batch) ? event.batch[0] : event;
	if (
		payload &&
		typeof payload === 'object' &&
		'start' in payload &&
		'end' in payload &&
		typeof payload.start === 'number' &&
		typeof payload.end === 'number'
	) {
		windowRange.value = [Math.max(0, payload.start), Math.min(100, payload.end)];
		selected.value = '';
		zoom.value = '可见范围已联动指标与三个图表';
	}
}
onMounted(load);
onBeforeUnmount(() => {
	++revision;
	latest.dispose();
});

function setModeModel(value: unknown) {
	modeModel.value = value;
}
</script>

							value="large"
							>{{ i18n.t('app.templates.visualization.sizelarge') }}</AsamOption
						><AsamOption
							:label="String(i18n.t('app.templates.visualization.sizebig')).trim()"
							value="big"
							>{{ i18n.t('app.templates.visualization.sizebig') }}</AsamOption
						><AsamOption
							:label="
								String(i18n.t('app.templates.visualization.sizedefault')).trim()

								String(i18n.t('app.templates.visualization.copy72726d8818')).trim()

							value="ZH"

			</nav>
			<Teleport to="#preview-settings-extra" :disabled="!websitePreviewControls"

<script setup lang="ts">
import { AsamConfigProvider as WebsiteAsamConfigProvider } from '@asam-ui/ui';
const websitePreviewControls =
	typeof document !== 'undefined' && !!document.getElementById('preview-settings-extra');
function websitePreviewTheme0(event: CustomEvent<'light' | 'dark'>) {
	setTheme(event.detail);
}
function websiteNativeEvent(value: unknown, type: string) {
	const event = new Event(type);
	Object.defineProperty(event, 'target', { value: { value, checked: value } });
	return event;
}

import { AsamSelect, AsamOption } from '@asam-ui/ui';

import { AsamButton } from '@asam-ui/ui';

import { AsamConfigProvider } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { AsamControlSize } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { useVisualizationI18n } from '../i18n/index.js';
const i18n = useVisualizationI18n();
import { onBeforeUnmount, ref } from 'vue';
import AnalyticsPage from './AnalyticsPage.vue';
import MonitorPage from './MonitorPage.vue';
import HostFixture from './HostFixture.vue';
import RepairFixture from './RepairFixture.vue';
import { createLocalAnalyticsService } from '../Services.js';
import GeometryControls from '../../cards/GeometryControls.vue';
import { createCardPresentation } from '../../cards/Presentation.js';
import { choiceModel } from '../../cards/Models.js';
const cardPresentation = ref(createCardPresentation('small'));
const page = ref(
	typeof window !== 'undefined' &&
		new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get('page') === 'monitor'
		? 'monitor'
		: 'analytics'
);
const themeState = ref<'light' | 'dark'>('light');
const theme = choiceModel(
	() => themeState.value,
	(value) => {
		themeState.value = value;
	},
	['light', 'dark']
);
const sizeState = ref<AsamControlSize>('default');
const size = choiceModel(
	() => sizeState.value,
	(value) => {
		sizeState.value = value;
	},
	['large', 'big', 'default', 'small']
);
const localeState = ref<'ZH' | 'EN'>('ZH');
const locale = choiceModel(
	() => localeState.value,
	(value) => {
		localeState.value = value;
	},
	['ZH', 'EN']
);
const service = createLocalAnalyticsService();
const fixture =
	typeof location !== 'undefined' && new URLSearchParams(location.search).has('fixture');
const repair =
	typeof location !== 'undefined' && new URLSearchParams(location.search).has('repair');
onBeforeUnmount(() => service.client.dispose());

function setTheme(value: unknown) {
	theme.value = value;
}
function setSize(value: unknown) {
	size.value = value;
}
function setLocale(value: unknown) {
	locale.value = value;
}
</script>

		<p>
			ready={{ ready }} selection={{ selection }} exported={{ exported }} zoomed={{ zoomed }}
		</p>
		<ChartHost
			:title="i18n.t('app.templates.visualization.copyed736c4e1f')"

		/><ChartHost
			:title="i18n.t('app.templates.visualization.copy31c13f78b1')"
			:series="series"
			:loading="true"
			:show-table="true"
		/><ChartHost
			:title="i18n.t('app.templates.visualization.copy4f2778639e')"
			:series="series"

<script setup lang="ts">
import { AsamSelect, AsamOption, AsamInput } from '@asam-ui/ui';

import { AsamButton } from '@asam-ui/ui';

import { useVisualizationI18n } from '../i18n/index.js';
const i18n = useVisualizationI18n();
import { computed, nextTick, onBeforeUnmount, ref, shallowRef } from 'vue';
import { AsamCardGroup, AsamStatisticCard } from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import { createRequestClient, TransportFault } from '@asam-ui/pro/application/transport';
import ChartHost from '../ChartHost.vue';
import { createMonitor } from '../Monitor.js';
import { createPollingSource, createSseSource } from '../Services.js';
import type { ChartSeries, MonitorSnapshot } from '../Types.js';
import type { CardPresentation } from '../../cards/Presentation.js';
import { choiceModel, textModel } from '../../cards/Models.js';
defineProps<{
	theme: 'light' | 'dark';
	locale: 'ZH' | 'EN';
	cardPresentation?: CardPresentation;
}>();
const displayState = (value: MonitorSnapshot['state']) => {
	const keys = {
		idle: 'app.templates.visualization.stateidle',
		connecting: 'app.templates.visualization.stateconnecting',
		live: 'app.templates.visualization.statelive',
		reconnecting: 'app.templates.visualization.statereconnecting',
		paused: 'app.templates.visualization.statepaused',
		stale: 'app.templates.visualization.statestale',
		error: 'app.templates.visualization.stateerror',
		closed: 'app.templates.visualization.stateclosed'
	} as const;
	return i18n.enabled.value ? i18n.t(keys[value]) : value;
};
const endpointState = ref(location.origin);
const endpoint = textModel(
	() => endpointState.value,
	(value) => {
		endpointState.value = value;
	}
);
const sourceKindState = ref('sse');
const sourceKind = choiceModel(
	() => sourceKindState.value,
	(value) => {
		sourceKindState.value = value;
	},
	['sse', 'poll']
);
const activeSourceKind = ref('');
const capacityState = ref(600);
const capacity = choiceModel(
	() => capacityState.value,
	(value) => {
		capacityState.value = value;
	},
	[600, 60]
);
const intervalState = ref(100);
const interval = choiceModel(
	() => intervalState.value,
	(value) => {
		intervalState.value = value;
	},
	[100, 500]
);
const streams = ['请求量', '延迟', '吞吐'];
const snapshot = shallowRef<MonitorSnapshot>({
	state: 'idle',
	source: '',
	attempts: 0,
	dropped: 0,
	lastAt: null,
	points: {}
});
const durations = ref<number[]>([]);
const p95 = computed(() => {
	const ordered = durations.value.slice().sort((a, b) => a - b);
	return ordered[Math.max(0, Math.ceil(ordered.length * 0.95) - 1)] ?? 0;
});
let alive = true;
const frames = new Set<number>();
function changed(value: MonitorSnapshot) {
	const start = performance.now();
	snapshot.value = value;
	void nextTick(() => {
		if (!alive) return;
		const frame = requestAnimationFrame(() => {
			frames.delete(frame);
			if (alive)
				durations.value = [...durations.value, performance.now() - start].slice(-300);
		});
		frames.add(frame);
	});
}
let monitor = createMonitor(
	{ streams, capacity: capacity.value, intervalMs: interval.value },
	changed
);
const client = createRequestClient({
	transport: async (input, context) => {
		try {
			const response = await fetch(input.url, { signal: context.signal });
			if (!response.ok) throw new TransportFault('network');
			return { mode: 'data', data: await response.json() };
		} catch {
			throw new TransportFault('network');
		}
	}
});
const count = computed(() =>
	Object.values(snapshot.value.points).reduce((n, p) => n + p.length, 0)
);
function start() {
	activeSourceKind.value = sourceKind.value;
	monitor.start(
		sourceKind.value === 'sse'
			? createSseSource(`${endpoint.value}/events?interval=${interval.value}`)
			: createPollingSource(client, `${endpoint.value}/poll`)
	);
}
function reconfigure() {
	monitor.dispose();
	monitor = createMonitor(
		{ streams, capacity: capacity.value, intervalMs: interval.value },
		changed
	);
	start();
}
function series(id: string): ChartSeries[] {
	return [
		{
			id,
			name: id,
			kind: 'line',
			points: (snapshot.value.points[id] ?? []).map((p) => ({
				id: String(p.seq),
				label: String(p.seq),
				value: p.value
			}))
		}
	];
}
onBeforeUnmount(() => {
	alive = false;
	for (const frame of frames) cancelAnimationFrame(frame);
	frames.clear();
	monitor.dispose();
	client.dispose();
});

function setEndpoint(value: unknown) {
	endpoint.value = value;
}
function setSourceKind(value: unknown) {
	sourceKind.value = value;
}
function setCapacity(value: unknown) {
	capacity.value = value;
}
function setInterval(value: unknown) {
	interval.value = value;
}
</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { AsamSelect, AsamOption } from '@asam-ui/ui';

import { AsamButton } from '@asam-ui/ui';

import { useVisualizationI18n } from '../i18n/index.js';
const i18n = useVisualizationI18n();
import { nextTick, onBeforeUnmount, ref } from 'vue';
import ChartHost from '../ChartHost.vue';
import AnalyticsPage from './AnalyticsPage.vue';
import type { ChartExpose, ChartSeries } from '../Types.js';
import { createRequestClient } from '@asam-ui/pro/application/transport';
import { decodeAnalytics } from '../Services.js';
import { choiceModel } from '../../cards/Models.js';
import type { AnalyticsService } from '../Services.js';
const mode = new URLSearchParams(location.search).get('repair');
const auto = ref<ChartExpose>();
const bare = ref<ChartExpose>();
const yes = ref<ChartExpose>();
const no = ref<ChartExpose>();
const theme = ref<'light' | 'dark'>('light');
const mounted = ref(true);
const states = ref({});
const series: ChartSeries[] = [
	{
		id: 'values',
		name: '合法数值',
		kind: 'line',
		points: [0, -2, 0.5, null].map((value, index) => ({
			id: String(index),
			label: String(index),
			value
		}))
	}
];
async function read() {
	await nextTick();
	states.value = {
		system: matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches,
		auto: auto.value?.getInstance()?.getOption().animation,
		bare: bare.value?.getInstance()?.getOption().animation,
		yes: yes.value?.getInstance()?.getOption().animation,
		no: no.value?.getInstance()?.getOption().animation
	};
}
const sampleState = ref('normal');
const sample = choiceModel(
	() => sampleState.value,
	(value) => {
		sampleState.value = value;
	},
	['normal', 'one-null', 'all-null', 'mixed', 'slow']
);
const client = createRequestClient({
	transport: async () => {
		const selected = sample.value;
		await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, selected === 'slow' ? 350 : 20));
		const values =
			selected === 'one-null'
				? [null]
				: selected === 'all-null'
					? [null, null, null]
					: selected === 'mixed'
						? [0, null, -2, 0.5]
						: selected === 'slow'
							? [999]
							: [0, 4, null];
		const points = values.map((value, index) => ({
			id: String(index),
			label: `样本 ${index}`,
			value
		}));
		return {
			mode: 'data',
			data: {
				points,
				total: values.reduce<number>((sum, value) => sum + (value ?? 0), 0),
				partial: false
			}
		};
	}
});
const service: AnalyticsService = {
	client,
	load: (filter, signal) =>
		client.request(
			{ url: 'fixture', params: { ...filter } },
			{ signal, decode: decodeAnalytics }
		)
};
onBeforeUnmount(() => client.dispose());

function setSample(value: unknown) {
	sample.value = value;
}
</script>

import { resolve, relative } from 'node:path';

// Keep the accepted loader's retryable dynamic import. Only resolve its URL to
// Vite's own emitted entry; the engine and chart algorithms remain unchanged.
export function asamVisualizationEngine(
	sourceRoot = resolve(import.meta.dirname, '..'),
	{ language = 'ts' } = {}
) {
	if (!['ts', 'js'].includes(language)) throw Error('图表引擎仅支持TS或JS同源入口');
	const engine = resolve(sourceRoot, `templates/visualization/Engine.${language}`);
	const loader = resolve(sourceRoot, `templates/visualization/EngineLoader.${language}`);
	const normalize = (path) => path.replaceAll('\\', '/');
	let config;
	return {
		name: 'asam-visualization-engine-url',
		configResolved(value) {
			config = value;
		},
		transform(code, id) {
			if (normalize(id.split('?')[0]) !== normalize(loader)) return;
			const marker = /['"]__ASAM_ENGINE_URL__['"]/;
			if (!marker.test(code)) this.error('EngineLoader.ts 缺少预期的引擎 URL 标记');
			const path = normalize(relative(config.root, engine));
			const devPath = path.startsWith('../') ? '@fs/' + normalize(engine) : path;
			const url =
				config.command === 'build'
					? `import.meta.ROLLUP_FILE_URL_${this.emitFile({ type: 'chunk', id: engine, name: 'Engine', preserveSignature: 'strict' })}`
					: // This is already a Vite-served URL with its base applied. Prevent
						// Vite's asset new-URL transform from resolving it as another file.
						`/* @vite-ignore */ ${JSON.stringify(config.base + encodeURI(devPath))}`;
			return { code: code.replace(marker, url), map: null };
		}
	};
}

import { createApp as createOwnerApp } from 'vue';
import { AsamI18nKey } from '@asam-ui/ui/i18n';
import { createApp } from 'vue';
import '@asam-ui/ui/style.css';
import '@asam-ui/pro/style.css';
import '../templates/visualization/Style.css';
import App from '../templates/visualization/examples/App.vue';
export async function mountWebsiteExample(element, onError, i18n) {
	const apps = [];
	const createApp = (...args) => {
		const app = createOwnerApp(...args);
		if (i18n) app.provide(AsamI18nKey, i18n);
		app.config.errorHandler = onError;
		apps.push(app);
		return app;
	};
	createApp(App).mount(element);
	return () => {
		for (const app of apps.reverse()) app.unmount();
	};
}

import { computed } from 'vue';
/** 公共输入允许清空或多种标量，页面模型只接收自己声明的合法值。 */
export function choiceModel(read, write, choices) {
	return computed({
		get: read,
		set(value) {
			if (choices.some((choice) => Object.is(choice, value))) write(value);
		}
	});
}
export function booleanModel(read, write) {
	return computed({
		get: read,
		set(value) {
			if (typeof value === 'boolean') write(value);
		}
	});
}
export function textModel(read, write) {
	return computed({
		get: read,
		set(value) {
			if (typeof value === 'string') write(value);
		}
	});
}

/** Validate before invoking the engine. Null is a gap, zero and signed decimals are values. */
export function validateSeries(series, scope) {
	const ids = new Set();
	for (const item of series) {
		if (!item.id || ids.has(item.id))
			return scope?.enabled.value
				? scope.t('app.templates.visualization.seriesId')
				: 'series ID 缺失或重复';
		ids.add(item.id);
		if (!['line', 'bar', 'pie'].includes(item.kind))
			return scope?.enabled.value
				? scope.t('app.templates.visualization.chartKind')
				: '未注册的图表类型';
		const points = new Set();
		for (const point of item.points) {
			if (!point.id || points.has(point.id))
				return scope?.enabled.value
					? scope.t('app.templates.visualization.pointId')
					: 'point ID 缺失或重复';
			points.add(point.id);
			if (point.value !== null && !Number.isFinite(point.value))
				return scope?.enabled.value
					? scope.t('app.templates.visualization.finite')
					: '图表值必须为有限数字或 null';
			if (item.kind === 'pie' && point.value !== null && point.value < 0)
				return scope?.enabled.value
					? scope.t('app.templates.visualization.negativePie')
					: '饼图不支持负数；请使用折线或柱图';
		}
	}
}

import { createAsamMessageError } from '@asam-ui/pro/i18n';
import { createRequestClient, TransportFault } from '@asam-ui/pro/application/transport';
export function decodeAnalytics(data) {
	if (
		typeof data !== 'object' ||
		!data ||
		!('points' in data) ||
		!Array.isArray(data.points) ||
		!('total' in data) ||
		typeof data.total !== 'number' ||
		!Number.isFinite(data.total) ||
		!('partial' in data) ||
		typeof data.partial !== 'boolean'

		throw createAsamMessageError(
			new TypeError('无效分析响应'),
			'app.templates.visualization.invalidResponse'
		);

	const points = data.points.map((p) => {
		if (
			typeof p !== 'object' ||
			!p ||
			!('id' in p) ||
			typeof p.id !== 'string' ||
			ids.has(p.id) ||
			!('label' in p) ||
			typeof p.label !== 'string' ||
			!('value' in p) ||
			(p.value !== null && (typeof p.value !== 'number' || !Number.isFinite(p.value)))
		)
			throw createAsamMessageError(
				new TypeError('无效分析点'),
				'app.templates.visualization.invalidPoint'
			);

/** Replace this local deterministic transport at application composition; no CL backend implied. */
export function createLocalAnalyticsService() {

		transport: async (input, context) => {
			const filter = input.params;
			await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
				const timer = setTimeout(resolve, filter.delayMs ?? 70);
				context.signal.addEventListener(
					'abort',
					() => {
						clearTimeout(timer);
						reject(new TransportFault('cancelled'));
					},
					{ once: true }
				);
			});
			if (filter.mode === 'error') throw new TransportFault('network');
			const length =
				filter.mode === 'empty'
					? 0
					: filter.mode === 'partial'
						? Math.floor(filter.range / 2)
						: filter.range;
			const multiplier =
				filter.category === 'north' ? 1.4 : filter.category === 'south' ? 0.7 : 1;
			const points = Array.from({ length }, (_, i) => ({
				id: String(i),
				label: `时段 ${i + 1}`,
				value:
					i % 97 === 0
						? null
						: Math.round((40 + Math.sin(i / 17) * 15 + (i % 13)) * multiplier * 100) /
							100
			}));
			return {
				mode: 'data',
				data: {
					points,
					total: points.reduce((n, p) => n + (p.value ?? 0), 0),
					partial: filter.mode === 'partial'
				}
			};
		}
	});

export function createSseSource(url, id = '本地 SSE') {
	return {
		id,
		subscribe(sink) {
			const event = new EventSource(url);
			event.onopen = () => sink.open();
			event.onmessage = (e) => {
				try {
					sink.message(JSON.parse(e.data));
				} catch {
					event.close();
					sink.error();
				}
			};
			event.onerror = () => {
				event.close();
				sink.error();
			};
			return {
				close() {
					event.onopen = null;
					event.onmessage = null;
					event.onerror = null;
					event.close();
				}
			};
		}
	};

export function createPollingSource(client, url, id = '本地 polling') {
	return {
		id,

								new TypeError('无效轮询响应'),
								'app.templates.visualization.invalidPolling'
							);
						return data;
					}
				}
			)
	};
}
css
.viz-shell {
	--viz-bg: var(--asam-color-surface-muted, #f3f6f7);
	--viz-surface: var(--asam-color-surface, #fff);
	--viz-text: var(--asam-color-text-primary, #20363e);
	--viz-border: var(--asam-color-border, #d8e1e5);
	--viz-control: 32px;
	background: var(--viz-bg);
	color: var(--viz-text);
	min-height: 100%;
	font: 14px/1.5 var(--asam-typography-font-family, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif);
}
.viz-shell.dark {
	color-scheme: dark;
}
.viz-shell[data-size='large'] {
	--viz-control: 40px;
}
.viz-shell[data-size='big'] {
	--viz-control: 36px;
}
.viz-shell[data-size='small'] {
	--viz-control: 28px;
}
body {
	margin: 0;
}
.viz-shell * {
	box-sizing: border-box;
}
.viz-shell nav {
	display: flex;
	align-items: center;
	gap: 16px;
	padding: 16px 3vw;
	border-bottom: 1px solid var(--viz-border);
	background: var(--viz-surface);
	flex-wrap: wrap;
}
.viz-shell nav strong {
	margin-right: auto;
	letter-spacing: 0.12em;
}
.viz-shell small {
	font-size: 10px;
	font-weight: 400;
}
.viz-shell button:not([class*='el-']),
.viz-shell input:not([class*='el-']),
.viz-shell select:not([class*='el-']) {
	font: inherit;
	color: inherit;
	background: var(--viz-surface);
	border: 1px solid var(--viz-border);
	border-radius: var(--asam-radius-control, 4px);
	min-height: var(--viz-control);
	line-height: 20px;
	padding: 3px 10px;
}
.viz-shell button:not([class*='el-']) {
	cursor: pointer;
}
.viz-shell button:not([class*='el-']):hover,
.viz-shell [aria-current='page']:not(.el-button) {
	border-color: var(--asam-semantic-primary-foreground);
	color: var(--asam-semantic-primary-foreground);
}
.viz-shell :focus-visible {
	outline: 3px solid var(--asam-semantic-focus);
	outline-offset: 3px;
}
.viz-shell input:not([class*='el-'])[type='checkbox'] {
	min-height: 0;
}
.viz-page {
	max-width: 1600px;
	margin: auto;
	padding: 28px 3vw;
}
.viz-heading {
	display: flex;
	justify-content: space-between;
	align-items: center;
	gap: 16px;
	margin-bottom: 22px;
}
.viz-heading h1 {
	font-size: 32px;
	letter-spacing: -0.035em;
	margin: 4px 0;
}
.viz-heading p {
	margin: 0;
	color: var(--asam-color-text-secondary, #657983);
}
.viz-eyebrow {
	font-size: 11px;
	letter-spacing: 0.12em;
}
.viz-toolbar {
	display: flex;
	align-items: end;
	gap: 12px;
	flex-wrap: wrap;
	margin-bottom: 16px;
}
.viz-toolbar label {
	display: grid;
	gap: 4px;
	font-size: 12px;
}
.viz-shell nav label {
	display: flex;
	align-items: center;
	gap: 5px;
}
.viz-analysis-grid {
	display: grid;
	grid-template-columns: 1.4fr 1fr;
	gap: 18px;
	margin-top: 24px;
}
.viz-analysis-grid > .viz-chart:first-child {
	grid-column: 1/-1;
}
.viz-monitor-grid {
	display: grid;
	grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
	gap: 16px;
	margin-top: 24px;
}
.viz-chart {
	min-width: 0;
	padding: 18px;
	background: var(--viz-surface);
	border: 1px solid var(--viz-border);
	border-radius: var(--asam-radius-card, 8px);
}
.viz-chart header {
	display: flex;
	justify-content: space-between;
}
.viz-chart h2 {
	font-size: 15px;
	margin: 0 0 12px;
}
.viz-chart .asam-form-section {
	border: 0;
	padding: 0;
	display: flex;
	gap: 12px;
	font-size: 12px;
}
.viz-chart .asam-form-section-title {
	font-size: 11px;
	color: var(--asam-color-text-secondary, #657983);
}
.viz-plot {
	width: 100%;
}
.viz-chart summary {
	cursor: pointer;
	font-size: 12px;
	margin-top: 12px;
}
.viz-table {
	max-height: 260px;
	overflow: auto;
}
.viz-table table {
	border-collapse: collapse;
	width: 100%;
	font-size: 12px;
}
.viz-table th,
.viz-table td {
	text-align: left;
	padding: 6px;
	border-bottom: 1px solid var(--viz-border);
}
.viz-status {
	border: 1px solid var(--viz-border);
	padding: 6px 12px;
	border-radius: 20px;
}
.viz-shell .asam-card-group {
	margin: 18px 0;
}
@media (max-width: 700px) {
	.viz-analysis-grid,
	.viz-monitor-grid {
		grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
	}
	.viz-heading h1 {
		font-size: 26px;
	}
	.viz-shell nav {
		gap: 9px;
	}
	.viz-shell nav strong {
		width: 100%;
	}
	.viz-toolbar input:not([class*='el-']) {
		max-width: 100%;
	}
	.viz-chart {
		padding: 12px;
	}
	.viz-page {
		padding: 20px 14px;
	}
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference) {
	.viz-shell button:not([class*='el-']) {
		transition:
			border-color 0.15s,
			color 0.15s;
	}
	.viz-page {
		animation: viz-enter 0.18s ease-out;
	}
	@keyframes viz-enter {
		from {
			opacity: 0.4;
			transform: translateY(3px);
		}
		to {
			opacity: 1;
			transform: none;
		}
	}
}

		if (range === 1000 || range === 100 || range === 30) filter.range = range;

const fields = computed(() => [
	{
		key: 'category',
		kind: 'single',
		label: i18n.t('app.templates.visualization.copy3382870bc4'),
		source: defineAsamOptions().static({
			options: [
				{ value: 'all', label: i18n.t('app.templates.visualization.copy83a18b9cc6') },
				{ value: 'north', label: i18n.t('app.templates.visualization.copy043bf68117') },
				{ value: 'south', label: i18n.t('app.templates.visualization.copydf398d3794') }
			]

		modes: { query: { componentProps: { onChange: load } } }
	},
	{
		key: 'range',
		kind: 'single',
		label: i18n.t('app.templates.visualization.copyae72b532f4'),
		source: defineAsamOptions().static({
			options: [
				{ value: 1000, label: i18n.t('app.templates.visualization.copy1a4ab19919') },
				{ value: 100, label: i18n.t('app.templates.visualization.copy9d35440791') },
				{ value: 30, label: i18n.t('app.templates.visualization.copy2387e543cf') }
			]
		}),
		modes: { query: { componentProps: { onChange: load } } }
	}
]);
const modeModel = choiceModel(
	() => filter.mode,
	(value) => {
		filter.mode = value;
	},
	['normal', 'empty', 'partial', 'error']
);
const data = ref({ points: [], total: 0, partial: false });
const loading = ref(false);
const error = ref('');
const selected = ref('');
const zoom = ref('');
const windowRange = ref([0, 100]);
const kinds = ['line', 'bar', 'pie'];
const titles = computed(() => ({
	line: i18n.t('app.templates.visualization.lineTitle'),
	bar: i18n.t('app.templates.visualization.barTitle'),
	pie: i18n.t('app.templates.visualization.pieTitle')
}));
const filtered = computed(() =>
	selected.value
		? data.value.points.filter((p) => p.id === selected.value)
		: data.value.points.slice(
				Math.floor((data.value.points.length * windowRange.value[0]) / 100),
				Math.ceil((data.value.points.length * windowRange.value[1]) / 100)
			)
);
const total = computed(() => filtered.value.reduce((n, p) => n + (p.value ?? 0), 0));
const validCount = computed(() => filtered.value.filter((p) => p.value !== null).length);
const status = computed(() =>
	loading.value
		? 'loading'
		: error.value
			? 'error'
			: !data.value.points.length
				? 'empty'
				: 'ready'
);
const latest = createLatestRequest(props.service.client, (result) => {
	data.value = result;
	selected.value = '';
	windowRange.value = [0, 100];
});
let revision = 0;

	const token = ++revision;
	loading.value = true;
	error.value = '';
	try {
		await latest.load(
			{ url: 'local:analytics', params: { ...filter } },
			{ decode: decodeAnalytics }

	} catch {

		if (token === revision) loading.value = false;
	}
}
function reset() {

	selected.value = '';
	void load();
}

	return [
		{

			name: filter.category === 'all' ? '全部区域' : filter.category,
			kind,
			points: filtered.value

	];
}

	if (!event || typeof event !== 'object') return;
	const payload = 'batch' in event && Array.isArray(event.batch) ? event.batch[0] : event;
	if (
		payload &&
		typeof payload === 'object' &&
		'start' in payload &&
		'end' in payload &&
		typeof payload.start === 'number' &&
		typeof payload.end === 'number'
	) {
		windowRange.value = [Math.max(0, payload.start), Math.min(100, payload.end)];
		selected.value = '';
		zoom.value = '可见范围已联动指标与三个图表';
	}

onMounted(load);

	++revision;
	latest.dispose();

}

import ChartHost from '../ChartHost.vue';
import { createMonitor } from '../Monitor.js';
import { createPollingSource, createSseSource } from '../Services.js';
import { choiceModel, textModel } from '../../cards/Models.js';
defineProps({
	theme: { type: String, required: true },
	locale: { type: String, required: true },
	cardPresentation: { type: Object, required: false }
});
const displayState = (value) => {
	const keys = {
		idle: 'app.templates.visualization.stateidle',
		connecting: 'app.templates.visualization.stateconnecting',
		live: 'app.templates.visualization.statelive',
		reconnecting: 'app.templates.visualization.statereconnecting',
		paused: 'app.templates.visualization.statepaused',
		stale: 'app.templates.visualization.statestale',
		error: 'app.templates.visualization.stateerror',
		closed: 'app.templates.visualization.stateclosed'
	};
	return i18n.enabled.value ? i18n.t(keys[value]) : value;
};
const endpointState = ref(location.origin);
const endpoint = textModel(
	() => endpointState.value,
	(value) => {
		endpointState.value = value;
	}
);
const sourceKindState = ref('sse');
const sourceKind = choiceModel(
	() => sourceKindState.value,
	(value) => {
		sourceKindState.value = value;
	},
	['sse', 'poll']
);
const activeSourceKind = ref('');
const capacityState = ref(600);
const capacity = choiceModel(
	() => capacityState.value,
	(value) => {
		capacityState.value = value;
	},
	[600, 60]
);
const intervalState = ref(100);
const interval = choiceModel(
	() => intervalState.value,
	(value) => {
		intervalState.value = value;
	},
	[100, 500]
);
const streams = ['请求量', '延迟', '吞吐'];
const snapshot = shallowRef({
	state: 'idle',
	source: '',
	attempts: 0,
	dropped: 0,
	lastAt: null,
	points: {}
});
const durations = ref([]);
const p95 = computed(() => {
	const ordered = durations.value.slice().sort((a, b) => a - b);
	return ordered[Math.max(0, Math.ceil(ordered.length * 0.95) - 1)] ?? 0;
});
let alive = true;
const frames = new Set();
function changed(value) {
	const start = performance.now();
	snapshot.value = value;
	void nextTick(() => {
		if (!alive) return;
		const frame = requestAnimationFrame(() => {
			frames.delete(frame);
			if (alive)
				durations.value = [...durations.value, performance.now() - start].slice(-300);
		});
		frames.add(frame);
	});
}
let monitor = createMonitor(
	{ streams, capacity: capacity.value, intervalMs: interval.value },
	changed
);
const client = createRequestClient({
	transport: async (input, context) => {
		try {
			const response = await fetch(input.url, { signal: context.signal });
			if (!response.ok) throw new TransportFault('network');
			return { mode: 'data', data: await response.json() };
		} catch {
			throw new TransportFault('network');
		}
	}
});
const count = computed(() =>
	Object.values(snapshot.value.points).reduce((n, p) => n + p.length, 0)
);
function start() {
	activeSourceKind.value = sourceKind.value;
	monitor.start(
		sourceKind.value === 'sse'
			? createSseSource(`${endpoint.value}/events?interval=${interval.value}`)
			: createPollingSource(client, `${endpoint.value}/poll`)
	);
}
function reconfigure() {
	monitor.dispose();
	monitor = createMonitor(
		{ streams, capacity: capacity.value, intervalMs: interval.value },
		changed
	);
	start();
}
function series(id) {
	return [
		{
			id,
			name: id,
			kind: 'line',
			points: (snapshot.value.points[id] ?? []).map((p) => ({
				id: String(p.seq),
				label: String(p.seq),
				value: p.value
			}))
		}
	];
}
onBeforeUnmount(() => {
	alive = false;
	for (const frame of frames) cancelAnimationFrame(frame);
	frames.clear();
	monitor.dispose();
	client.dispose();
});
function setEndpoint(value) {
	endpoint.value = value;
}
function setSourceKind(value) {
	sourceKind.value = value;
}
function setCapacity(value) {
	capacity.value = value;
}
function setInterval(value) {
	interval.value = value;
}
</script>

<template>
	<main v-if="mode === 'motion' || mode === 'init'" class="viz-page">
		<AsamButton @click="read" type="primary">{{
			i18n.t('app.templates.visualization.copy84816aa9e3')
		}}</AsamButton
		><AsamButton @click="theme = theme === 'light' ? 'dark' : 'light'" type="primary">{{
			i18n.t('app.templates.visualization.copyb91b56e708')
		}}</AsamButton
		><AsamButton @click="mounted = !mounted" type="primary">{{
			i18n.t('app.templates.visualization.copy735ca48fff')
		}}</AsamButton
		><template v-if="mounted"
			><ChartHost
				ref="auto"
				:title="i18n.t('app.templates.visualization.copy2464ef72d1')"
				:series="series"
				:theme="theme"
				@ready="read" /><ChartHost
				v-if="mode === 'motion'"
				ref="bare"
				:title="i18n.t('app.templates.visualization.copyebe055c4d9')"
				:series="series"
				reduced-motion
				:theme="theme"
				@ready="read" /><ChartHost
				v-if="mode === 'motion'"
				ref="yes"
				:title="i18n.t('app.templates.visualization.copyfb539d0709')"
				:series="series"
				:reduced-motion="true"
				:theme="theme"
				@ready="read" /><ChartHost
				v-if="mode === 'motion'"
				ref="no"
				:title="i18n.t('app.templates.visualization.copyddfc266130')"
				:series="series"
				:reduced-motion="false"
				:theme="theme"
				@ready="read"
		/></template>
	</main>
	<template v-else
		><div class="viz-toolbar">
			<label
				>{{ i18n.t('app.templates.visualization.copy1316b3c923')
				}}<AsamSelect
					:model-value="sample"
					@update:model-value="setSample"
					:aria-label="i18n.t('app.templates.visualization.copy1316b3c923')"
					><AsamOption
						:label="String(i18n.t('app.templates.visualization.sampleNormal')).trim()"
						value="normal"
						>{{ i18n.t('app.templates.visualization.sampleNormal') }}</AsamOption
					><AsamOption
						:label="String(i18n.t('app.templates.visualization.sampleOneNull')).trim()"
						value="one-null"
						>{{ i18n.t('app.templates.visualization.sampleOneNull') }}</AsamOption
					><AsamOption
						:label="String(i18n.t('app.templates.visualization.sampleAllNull')).trim()"
						value="all-null"
						>{{ i18n.t('app.templates.visualization.sampleAllNull') }}</AsamOption
					><AsamOption
						:label="String(i18n.t('app.templates.visualization.sampleMixed')).trim()"
						value="mixed"
						>{{ i18n.t('app.templates.visualization.sampleMixed') }}</AsamOption
					><AsamOption
						:label="String(i18n.t('app.templates.visualization.sampleSlow')).trim()"
						value="slow"
						>{{ i18n.t('app.templates.visualization.sampleSlow') }}</AsamOption
					></AsamSelect
				></label
			>
		</div>
		<AnalyticsPage :service="service" theme="light" locale="ZH"
	/></template>
</template>
<script setup>
import { AsamSelect, AsamOption } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { AsamButton } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { useVisualizationI18n } from '../i18n/index.js';
const i18n = useVisualizationI18n();
import { nextTick, onBeforeUnmount, ref } from 'vue';
import ChartHost from '../ChartHost.vue';
import AnalyticsPage from './AnalyticsPage.vue';
import { createRequestClient } from '@asam-ui/pro/application/transport';
import { decodeAnalytics } from '../Services.js';
import { choiceModel } from '../../cards/Models.js';
const mode = new URLSearchParams(location.search).get('repair');
const auto = ref();
const bare = ref();
const yes = ref();
const no = ref();
const theme = ref('light');
const mounted = ref(true);
const states = ref({});
const series = [
	{
		id: 'values',
		name: '合法数值',
		kind: 'line',
		points: [0, -2, 0.5, null].map((value, index) => ({
			id: String(index),
			label: String(index),
			value
		}))
	}
];
async function read() {
	await nextTick();
	states.value = {
		system: matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches,
		auto: auto.value?.getInstance()?.getOption().animation,
		bare: bare.value?.getInstance()?.getOption().animation,
		yes: yes.value?.getInstance()?.getOption().animation,
		no: no.value?.getInstance()?.getOption().animation
	};
}
const sampleState = ref('normal');
const sample = choiceModel(
	() => sampleState.value,
	(value) => {
		sampleState.value = value;
	},
	['normal', 'one-null', 'all-null', 'mixed', 'slow']
);
const client = createRequestClient({
	transport: async () => {
		const selected = sample.value;
		await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, selected === 'slow' ? 350 : 20));
		const values =
			selected === 'one-null'
				? [null]
				: selected === 'all-null'
					? [null, null, null]
					: selected === 'mixed'
						? [0, null, -2, 0.5]
						: selected === 'slow'
							? [999]
							: [0, 4, null];
		const points = values.map((value, index) => ({
			id: String(index),
			label: `样本 ${index}`,
			value
		}));
		return {
			mode: 'data',
			data: {
				points,
				total: values.reduce((sum, value) => sum + (value ?? 0), 0),
				partial: false
			}
		};
	}
});
const service = {
	client,
	load: (filter, signal) =>
		client.request(
			{ url: 'fixture', params: { ...filter } },
			{ signal, decode: decodeAnalytics }
		)
};
onBeforeUnmount(() => client.dispose());
function setSample(value) {
	sample.value = value;
}
</script>

js
import { resolve, relative } from 'node:path';

// Keep the accepted loader's retryable dynamic import. Only resolve its URL to
// Vite's own emitted entry; the engine and chart algorithms remain unchanged.
export function asamVisualizationEngine(
	sourceRoot = resolve(import.meta.dirname, '..'),
	{ language = 'js' } = {}
) {
	if (!['ts', 'js'].includes(language)) throw Error('图表引擎仅支持TS或JS同源入口');
	const engine = resolve(sourceRoot, `templates/visualization/Engine.${language}`);
	const loader = resolve(sourceRoot, `templates/visualization/EngineLoader.${language}`);
	const normalize = (path) => path.replaceAll('\\', '/');
	let config;
	return {
		name: 'asam-visualization-engine-url',
		configResolved(value) {
			config = value;
		},
		transform(code, id) {
			if (normalize(id.split('?')[0]) !== normalize(loader)) return;
			const marker = /['"]__ASAM_ENGINE_URL__['"]/;
			if (!marker.test(code)) this.error('EngineLoader.ts 缺少预期的引擎 URL 标记');
			const path = normalize(relative(config.root, engine));
			const devPath = path.startsWith('../') ? '@fs/' + normalize(engine) : path;
			const url =
				config.command === 'build'
					? `import.meta.ROLLUP_FILE_URL_${this.emitFile({ type: 'chunk', id: engine, name: 'Engine', preserveSignature: 'strict' })}`
					: // This is already a Vite-served URL with its base applied. Prevent
						// Vite's asset new-URL transform from resolving it as another file.
						`/* @vite-ignore */ ${JSON.stringify(config.base + encodeURI(devPath))}`;
			return { code: code.replace(marker, url), map: null };
		}
	};
}

import { defineConfig } from 'vite';
import vue from '@vitejs/plugin-vue';
import { asamVisualizationEngine } from './engine-plugin.mjs';

// Run from the consuming project root. Merge the engine plugin into an existing
// configuration instead of replacing the application's unrelated Vite options.
export default defineConfig({
	plugins: [vue(), asamVisualizationEngine()]
});

分析与监控的统计卡复用统一自适应布局，图表和数据读取沿用原有宿主。

分析统计卡监控统计卡

布局与接入

卡片密度提供四档及自定义最小宽度，列数留空时自动铺满父容器，最大宽度留空时不限制。几何配置不改变按钮与输入框的控件尺寸。使用公开 AsamProList／AsamCardGroup，瀑布流由正常 ASAM 组件负责。

接口与行为

可视化公开协议 ​

Types.ts 是类型事实来源。此目录是独立 Vue 应用模板，ECharts 不进入 UI/Pro 根包。

ChartHost ​

必填 title 与只读 series。每个系列有唯一 id/name/kind/points，每点有唯一 id/label/value；line、bar 支持负数，pie 明确拒绝负数。0、小数保留，null 为缺失，空集合为空；NaN/Infinity、重复 ID、未注册类型显示诊断。父数据不修改。

可选 option 是可信应用代码构造的 EChartsCoreOption；自有 series、aria 与默认渲染职责见源码，禁止将远端 JSON 作为可信 formatter 执行。默认 tooltip 使用 richText，无 HTML 拼接。应用自定义 option/formatter 的安全责任归宿主。

loading/error/theme/locale/reducedMotion/showTable/height：loading/showTable 是 Boolean，支持静态属性和绑定布尔值；默认 false。theme=light/dark、locale=ZH/EN。height 默认280。reducedMotion 未传时跟随系统。语义表格与图例提供键盘等价入口；并不声明已完成所有读屏组合验证。

事件：ready（当前实例就绪）、retry、select（seriesId/pointId/index/value）、legend（当前名称到可见性）、zoom（原生事件）、error（安全诊断）。引擎真实加载/初始化失败显示受控诊断；重试按钮在重新初始化宿主的同时发出 retry 供父级重试数据。成功模块复用，失败加载用新的本地 URL 避免浏览器缓存拒绝的 import；保留本模板 vite.config.ts 的引擎入口插件，复制到其他构建器时须提供等价的正常模块 URL 生成，不得改为CDN或源码副本。expose：resize、dispose、getInstance、dispatchAction、getDataURL。dispose 是终止操作，重新使用请重新挂载。theme/locale 重建实例，旧异步初始化被代次隔离；ResizeObserver 处理隐藏恢复，卸载清理 observer、RAF、media listener 和实例。SSR 可导入/渲染宿主壳，图表仅 mounted 后加载，不承诺完整 hydration。

默认 SVG，仅验证 line/bar/pie 与 legend/tooltip/dataZoom/click；没有内置 Canvas 或其他图种。显式扩展应改 Engine.ts 的正常按需注册及公开类型并自行补测，不复制上游算法。

分析服务 ​

AnalyticsService.client 是035正常 RequestClient；AnalyticsPage 自己持有 createLatestRequest，避免晚到覆盖。请求 input.params 即 AnalyticsFilter，decodeAnalytics 验证响应。替换本地 service 的 client.transport 即可对接宿主服务，不需要 CL API。load 供非页面消费者直接读取；页面的 latest 保护属于页面生命周期。本地确定性响应清楚标识为演示。累计量只相加非null数值；有效时段计数包含0、负数和小数，平均量以有效时段为分母，全null或没有有效值时平均量传null/显示缺失。

实时控制器 ​

createMonitor(options, changed) 返回 start/pause/resume/reconnect/close/dispose/snapshot/resources。streams 唯一且非空，capacity 默认600且限制1～600；intervalMs默认100、范围50～60000；batchMs默认100且最小100（至多10Hz）；reconnects默认3、范围0～10；backoffMs默认1000、范围100～10000，指数退避封顶10000。默认失败重连等待1/2/4秒，成功连接不会偷偷补充已耗尽的次数；显式重连/继续重新给次数。

SubscribeSource.subscribe 接收 open/message/error 回调，返回 close。createSseSource 真实使用 EventSource，禁用其隐式重试，由控制器管理限次重连。WebSocket 非内置，宿主可实现协议。PollSource.poll(signal) 通过035 RequestClient；仅前轮 settled 后安排下一轮，没有重叠。polling失败显示error，下一轮继续读请求；不会自动重试写请求。

每次连接建立独立代次并清空显示窗口，seq 从0重新有效；重复、倒序、非法值拒绝，dropped 包括拒绝、队列超限、窗口淘汰及清理时未提交点。每流 pending 与保留窗口分别均不超过capacity；暂停直接关源并丢弃未提交点，不积压。snapshot 是副本，lastAt 是真实源时间戳，stale 使用最后有效接收时间（无有效点时用本次连接起始时间）超过三次预期间隔判断。成功空轮询、重复/非法点不会刷新活性或把stale覆盖为live，只有合法新点恢复；seq=0/at=0/value=0均有效。idle 尚未启动；connecting 建连；live 已打开或收到数据；reconnecting 限次等待/建连；paused 用户暂停；stale 无数据；error 限次耗尽或轮询失败；closed 手动关闭。dispose 终止且不再通知，无后台自动唤醒。

同作用域双语展示 ​

复制 i18n/ 与原EngineLoader/Vite插件。ChartHost读取统一UI scope，组件自有语义表、ARIA、默认数字展示和受控错误随语言更新；props.error、title、series名/分类、option及宿主formatter保持原值/优先级。统一scope切语只用公开setOption合并自有presentation选项，不dispose/init，不重置series、legend或dataZoom。显式props.theme/props.locale仍保留原有重建协议。validateSeries追加可选AsamI18n参数，省略保持原始诊断，error事件仍发原文。资源不进入Pro核心，ECharts仍只属于应用模板。公开ARIA依据：https://echarts.apache.org/handbook/en/best-practices/aria/ 。真实SSE/轮询后端、全部读屏组合和完整SSR hydration不由本次国际化回归宣称。

完整类型

ts
import type { EChartsCoreOption, EChartsType } from 'echarts/core';
export type ChartKind = 'line' | 'bar' | 'pie';
export interface ChartPoint {
	readonly id: string;
	readonly label: string;
	readonly value: number | null;
}
export interface ChartSeries {
	readonly id: string;
	readonly name: string;
	readonly kind: ChartKind;
	readonly points: readonly ChartPoint[];
	readonly color?: string;
}
export interface ChartSelection {
	seriesId: string;
	pointId: string;
	index: number;
	value: number | null;
}
export interface ChartProps {
	title: string;
	series: readonly ChartSeries[];
	/** Trusted application option only. Never deserialize executable formatters from remote input. */
	option?: EChartsCoreOption;
	loading?: boolean;
	error?: string;
	theme?: 'light' | 'dark';
	locale?: 'ZH' | 'EN';
	/** Omitted follows the live system preference; explicit false enables animation. */
	reducedMotion?: boolean;
	showTable?: boolean;
	height?: number;
}
export interface ChartExpose {
	resize(): void;
	dispose(): void;
	getInstance(): EChartsType | undefined;
	dispatchAction(action: Parameters<EChartsType['dispatchAction']>[0]): void;
	getDataURL(): string | undefined;
}
export type ConnectionState =
	'idle' | 'connecting' | 'live' | 'reconnecting' | 'paused' | 'stale' | 'error' | 'closed';
export interface StreamPoint {
	readonly stream: string;
	readonly seq: number;
	readonly at: number;
	readonly value: number | null;
}
export interface Subscription {
	close(): void;
}
export interface StreamSink {
	open(): void;
	message(point: StreamPoint): void;
	error(): void;
}
export interface SubscribeSource {
	readonly id: string;
	subscribe(sink: StreamSink): Subscription;
}
export interface PollSource {
	readonly id: string;
	poll(signal: AbortSignal): Promise<readonly StreamPoint[]>;
}
export type MonitorSource = SubscribeSource | PollSource;
export interface MonitorOptions {
	streams: readonly string[];
	capacity?: number;
	intervalMs?: number;
	batchMs?: number;
	reconnects?: number;
	backoffMs?: number;
}
export interface MonitorSnapshot {
	state: ConnectionState;
	source: string;
	attempts: number;
	dropped: number;
	lastAt: number | null;
	points: Readonly<Record<string, readonly StreamPoint[]>>;
}
export interface AnalyticsFilter {
	category: 'all' | 'north' | 'south';
	range: number;
	mode: 'normal' | 'empty' | 'partial' | 'error';
	delayMs?: number;
}
export interface AnalyticsData {
	readonly points: readonly ChartPoint[];
	readonly total: number;
	readonly partial: boolean;
}
